items.title: Tesla (TSLA), SpaceX race for year-end merger deal before new Congress
items.teaser: Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX are working toward a year-end deadline to agree on their all-stock merger, according to the Financial Times. A signed deal by December 31 would land days before the new Congress, where Democrats have promised to dig into Musk’s companies, is sworn in on January 3. The FT also named the directors negotiating for each side. Two of Tesla’s three are the same people who designed Musk’s $1 trillion pay package.

items.title: SpaceX launches classified payload for the U.S. Space Force
items.teaser: The mission is the third in a series of flights for the U.S. Space Force with a ‘TH’ designation in public filings. Liftoff from pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base is scheduled during a window that opens at 7:55 a.m. PST (10:55 a.m. EST / 1555 UTC).
